verdict.rationale: Xero's docs describe paying multiple bills in one go through an exported batch payment file that marks the bills as paid. They also describe JAX automatically categorizing and matching many bank transactions. These are real bulk operations, but they are limited to specific workflows, and nothing shows bulk or batch operations through the API, SDK or MCP server for agent-driven use. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API or MCP operations across arbitrary item types (invoices, contacts, etc.), bulk edit/delete capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
